nodes.plm_action: Adjusting side mirror angle to view rear mirror of adjacent vehicle
nodes.plm_caption: The video shows the view from inside a car of a driver parking in a car park. The driver drives between two parked cars and stops as if to park. The man moves and gets out of the car.

summary.brief: A driver maneuvers his car into a parking bay between a blue vehicle and a white vehicle and then exits the vehicle.
summary.detailed: The video opens with an interior view as the driver approaches a gap bounded by a blue car on one side and a white car on the other. He looks through the passenger‑side rear window and checks both side mirrors to locate the far side of the opening, then steers the wheel to a full right lock to angle the front of the car past the first parked vehicle. After the front clears, he straightens the wheels and aligns the car with the empty bay. He then shifts into reverse, looks over his left shoulder and through the left‑hand window, and backs the car slowly while turning the wheel to a full left lock, continuously checking the left‑hand mirror to keep clear of both parked cars. Small forward adjustments are made to ensure enough clearance on each side, after which he straightens the wheels, brings the car to a stop centered between the two cars, and finally opens the door and gets out of the vehicle.

action.detailed: Drive forward into the gap, steer fully right to pass the first parked car, straighten the wheels, then reverse while steering fully left, using the side mirrors and windows to keep clear of both vehicles, adjust as needed, straighten the wheels and stop centered between the two cars.

nodes.plm_caption: This is a good quality recording of someone demonstrating how to drive a car with music in the background. It shows the interior of the car and the person navigating the vehicle between the parking spaces in a small car park. The shot is taken through the windscreen and shows the person turning right and then driving forward past a white car. Then the shot cuts to the driver driving down the side of the white car towards the back. Then they reverse back out of the car park. The camera switches to view from the passenger's perspective which is taken from the side door and then goes out of shot by the driver turning their neck. The shot cuts again to the interior of the car which shows the driver turning their head to the right and looking into a mirror on the side door. The camera then cuts to show the driver swerving from right to left before turning their car around to leave the car park. The shot then cuts to show the backside of the white car in the rear of the car park. All of this is happening while music is playing in the background, although it is difficult to tell what songs this is. The first song is a male singer and the second is a male and female duo. Overall, the video shows a great demonstration of the basics of driving in a car.

summary.brief: The driver steers the car into a tight bay between a white and a blue vehicle, checks both side mirrors, then backs out of the space.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a red on‑screen title and shows a man seated on the right‑hand side of a black sedan. He drives forward past a white car, looks out the passenger‑side rear window to see the far side of his own vehicle, and then turns the steering wheel to a full‑lock right to angle the car toward the empty space between the white car on his right and a blue car on his left. He repeatedly checks the right‑hand and left‑hand mirrors, adjusts the angle, and shunts forward to centre the vehicle in the bay. He then repeats the procedure using the left‑hand side window, prepares to reverse, and backs up slowly with the wheel in full‑lock left while continuously checking both mirrors. Once the car is clear of the adjacent vehicles, he straightens the wheels and drives forward out of the bay, completing the parking demonstration.

action.detailed: Steer the vehicle into the space between the white and blue cars, using side‑window views and full‑lock turns while checking both side mirrors, then reverse with the steering wheel turned left and straighten to exit the bay.
action.actor: the driver, a man seated on the right‑hand side of the car

nodes.plm_caption:
A video of a car's interior is seen driving past other parked cars. The camera moves back and forth between the backseat and the side mirror.
The car the camera is in is a red vehicle. The camera moves to show a blue car with an orange license plate. The blue car is parked on the other side of the grey road.

summary.brief: Inside a red car with open windows, the view shifts from the rear window showing a parked blue car and nearby buildings to the side‑mirror where a blue car passes by amid a parking‑lot backdrop.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a view from the rear seat of a red car whose windows are open; through the back window the camera sees a blue car parked on the opposite side of the road, a white car behind it, brick houses and an overcast sky. The interior shows black seats with a gray headrest on the left. The camera then pans across the cabin, still showing the open windows, as the blue car and surrounding parked vehicles become visible through the side windows. A larger blue vehicle is seen driving past in the background, followed by a white car. The perspective later shifts to the passenger‑side window and the right‑hand side‑mirror, where the view zooms in and out, tracking a blue car moving past while other parked cars and houses appear in the mirror’s reflection. Throughout, the red car moves forward past these parked vehicles, so the interior camera continually reveals the outside scene through the windows and mirror.

action.detailed: Drive the red car forward past the parked blue car while the camera pans from the rear window to the side‑mirror, showing the interior and the outside scene.
action.actor: The driver inside the red car

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a man parking a car in a parking lot. He drives towards an empty parking space and stops. He then adjusts the front camera before parking between the two vehicles in the parking spot.
The car is driven through a wet and rainy parking lot. The driver's seat is on the right-hand side and the camera pans to show the backseat and the back of the car before returning to the driver's seat. The parking lot includes several blue and white vehicles.
The scene includes several red brick houses with grey sloping roofs and trees with white bark and some grass.

summary.brief: A driver maneuvers a black sedan into a parking bay between a blue car and a white car.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a red on‑screen title reading “Bay Parking Between 2 Cars Right & Left.” A male driver, seated on the right‑hand side of a black four‑door sedan, begins by turning the steering wheel while the camera shows the dashboard and a view through the windshield of a blue sedan passing on the road and a white hatchback parked nearby. Rain falls, making the pavement wet, and red‑brick houses with grey roofs line the background. The driver steers the car forward past the two parked vehicles, uses the passenger‑side window and both side mirrors to locate the far side of the white car, and confirms that nothing is moving. He then applies a full right‑hand lock on the steering wheel to angle the car into the narrow gap between the blue and white vehicles. Once the car is positioned, he straightens the wheels, centers the vehicle in the bay, and makes a final adjustment forward to sit squarely between the cars. During the maneuver a red caption “Far side of the white car” appears over a view of the white car’s rear, and the interior view briefly shifts to show the back window and dashboard. Throughout, the rainy weather, wet road surface, and surrounding residential scenery are visible.

action.detailed: Steer the sedan forward, check the left‑ and right‑hand mirrors, apply a full right‑hand lock to angle the vehicle into the gap between the blue and white cars, verify that the far side of the white car is clear, then straighten the wheels and adjust the position to complete the parking maneuver.
action.actor: The male driver seated on the right side of the black sedan

nodes.plm_caption: This video captures the side mirror and side windows of a moving car driving in a city. The camera moves between the front of the car and the side mirrors, capturing several other vehicles in the frame. The video is shot with the camera focused on the side of the car, resulting in several different reflections in the video.

summary.brief: The driver films the interior, checks mirrors and surrounding traffic, and slowly steers the car into a parking spot while rain falls outside.
summary.detailed: The segment opens on the dark‑gray dashboard with two air vents, a piece of paper on the centre console and rain streaming down the windshield, showing a wet parking lot and a distant building. An off‑screen person talks about the dashboard and the radio, picks up a tool, holds it to the dashboard and then moves it toward the radio. The car door is opened, a newspaper flutters in the wind, and the view continues to show the side‑view mirror reflecting a red car parked at a distance. The driver’s hands grip the black steering wheel, and the driver turns the head left to look out the left window, seeing a blue car and another red car. The driver repeatedly checks the side mirror, adjusts the steering wheel and slowly maneuvers the vehicle through the parking lot, keeping an eye on surrounding traffic. The camera pans the mirror to the right, showing a blue car, then to the left, showing a white car, along with long grassy lanes and a red‑brick building, ending with the car positioned between the nearby vehicles.

action.detailed: Check the side‑view mirror, turn the head left to scan traffic, grip the steering wheel, and slowly steer the vehicle while adjusting the wheel angle to position the car between nearby parked vehicles.
action.actor: The driver inside the car (the person filming)

nodes.plm_caption: The video shows an interior shot of a car with the windows open. The shot is taken from inside the car looking out through the windows of the car. The focus of the car looks to be the rear window and the view out the window is the the blue car parked next to the car. The view pans to the car seats of the car the video is shot in. The seats appear to be black, with a gray head rest to the left.

summary.brief: Inside a parked car with the rear window partly open, the camera pans past a dark interior while a blue car outside flashes its brake lights and then drives past the window.
summary.detailed: The clip stays inside a stationary vehicle whose rear window is partially rolled down. Through the opening two parked cars are visible – a blue car on the right and a white car on the left – framed by brick houses and an overcast sky. The blue car’s rear brake lights flash. The camera slowly pans across the dark interior, showing black seats and a gray headrest on the left. As the pan continues, the blue car moves from right to left across the view, its red brake light flashing twice before it disappears out of frame. The interior remains still for the rest of the segment, ending with a quiet view of the blue car still visible through the open window.

action.detailed: The blue car drives past the stationary vehicle, moving from right to left across the view seen through the open rear window while its brake light flashes twice.

nodes.plm_caption: The video shows the right side mirror in a car as the camera pans around. The video takes a few seconds to pan around before zooming in and then zooming out. It then zooms in again and pans left to show a blue car passing by before zooming out. The background is a parking lot filled with cars and houses.

summary.brief: The driver looks through the right‑hand side mirror while the car moves through a residential parking area, showing a red car behind and a blue car passing.
summary.detailed: Inside the vehicle the camera focuses on the right‑hand side mirror. It pans and briefly zooms before returning to a steady view. In the mirror a stationary red car can be seen behind the host vehicle, and a blue car approaches from the opposite direction, passes across the mirror’s field of view and continues onward. The driver periodically glances at the mirror as the vehicle drifts forward through a parking lot surrounded by houses, lawns, fences and an overcast sky. Interior details such as the dashboard vents, steering wheel and a piece of paper on the windshield are also visible, but the primary visual activity is the side‑mirror view of the surrounding traffic.

action.brief: Drive forward and check side mirror
action.detailed: The driver continues to drive forward, repeatedly turning his head to glance at the right‑hand side mirror, which shows a red car behind and a blue car moving past as the vehicle proceeds through the parking lot.

nodes.plm_caption: A man is attempting to park his car. The video shows the movements of the car. The text "Bay Parking. Between Two Cars Right and Left" is shown at the start of the video and is red in colour.

summary.brief: A driver follows on‑screen instructions and maneuvers a dark sedan into a narrow parking bay between a blue car and a white car, then an interior view shows the parked cars with a red caption.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with red on‑screen text announcing a bay‑parking lesson. A driver sits in the front of a dark four‑door sedan and drives forward down a residential street lined with houses. Through the windshield and the passenger‑side window he passes a blue car on the left and a white car on the right, checking the far side of the white vehicle with his side mirrors. He steers the vehicle into the narrow gap between the two parked cars, makes a small forward‑and‑backward adjustment, straightens the wheels and brings the car to a stop centered in the bay. The camera then switches to an interior view from the back seat; the rear window frames the white car and a blue car beside it, with red‑brick houses in the background, and a red overlay reads “Far side of the White Car.”

action.detailed: Drive the sedan forward, align it between the blue car on the left and the white car on the right, check the side mirrors and the far side of the white car through the passenger‑side window, steer to angle the vehicle into the narrow gap, make a slight adjustment, straighten the wheels and bring the car to a stop centered in the bay.
action.actor: The driver seated in the front of a dark four‑door sedan

nodes.plm_caption: This video features a dash cam footage of the back of a white vehicle from the inside passenger seat, driving around a car park in an upward arc, revealing the blue vehicle it is passing on the right. Then it pans the right to show the driver's door and a blue car. The vehicle has no driver and is unoccupied.

summary.brief: A white hatchback backs out of a residential parking spot and repositions between a blue car and the curb, followed by interior shots of another vehicle and a passing blue sedan.
summary.detailed: The video opens from the rear‑window view of a moving car, showing a white Ford Fiesta hatchback parked next to a blue sedan in a small residential lot with red‑brick houses, grass and an overcast sky. The white hatchback reverses out of the space; the driver checks the far side and uses the side mirrors for clearance. It then drives forward, steers to straighten itself, and stops positioned between the blue car and the curb. The camera briefly pans to the driver’s door and dashboard of the interior vehicle as a passenger quickly turns his head left. The view shifts to the dashboard, displaying the air vent, windshield and road ahead while the vehicle continues forward. A blue sedan appears on the right, its passenger‑side door and side mirror coming into view, and the camera follows it as it passes. The segment ends with a close‑up of the blue car’s door and mirror, then a short interior shot of the camera car moving toward a parking area.

action.detailed: Back the white hatchback straight out of the parking space, check the far side and mirrors for clearance, then steer to align the vehicle between the blue car and the curb before stopping.

An off‑screen presenter briefly comments on the dashboard, reaches into the centre console, lifts a hand‑held tool, holds it near the dashboard and then slides it across the interior toward the radio while continuing to talk to the camera. The vehicle remains stationary and the external scenery does not change during this segment.

summary.brief: The driver checks mirrors, looks left at nearby cars, steers into a parking space between a red and a blue vehicle, then drives away while the interior camera pans around the surroundings.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a close‑up of the left rear‑view mirror showing a red car behind the driver’s vehicle. The driver’s hands rest on the steering wheel as he glances at the mirror, then turns his head left to scan the left side window, where a blue car and another red car are visible in the parking lot. He maneuvers the car into the gap between those two parked vehicles, repeatedly checking the side and rear‑view mirrors before bringing the vehicle to a stop. The view shifts to the dashboard, where the windshield wipers are raised and a small piece of paper rests in the air‑vent. The camera then pans slowly across the interior, showing the steering wheel and mirror as the car moves away from a red car. Finally, the driver pans the camera to the right, revealing a blue car, then to the left, showing a white car, with grassy lane paths and a red‑brick building in the background.

action.detailed: Steer the vehicle into the space between the parked red and blue cars while repeatedly checking the side and rear‑view mirrors and turning the head left to verify clearance, then bring the car to a stop and later drive forward away from the spot.

summary.brief: The driver turns left while the side‑mirror shows a red car behind and a blue car entering, turning left and passing.

The driver steers the vehicle to the left, keeping an eye on the mirror. The blue car approaches, turns left and moves forward past the driver, while the red car remains visible in the mirror. The camera briefly shows dashboard details such as the steering wheel, air vents and a piece of paper on the windshield before returning to the side‑mirror view, now showing the blue car directly ahead with its fuel flap open and the red car still reflected behind. The interior view continues until the end of the segment.

action.detailed: The driver steers the vehicle left while watching the side‑mirror, allowing the blue car to turn left and pass and keeping the red car in view behind.

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features an instructional montage of a man parking his car between two cars. The man is in a black, four-door sedan. The other cars are white and blue. The man is in a parking lot with buildings in the background. Other cars drive around during this video.
The red text "Bay Parking Between 2 Cars Right & Left" flashes on the screen at the beginning of the video. It then fades away from the screen as the man drives the car toward the parking lot.

It is difficult to discern what shot the video was cut using, since there are only two vehicles in view. The video features a montage of other cars driving down the road, so it is hard to determine what specific cars were involved in the shoot. The video was taken from the view of the driver's seat.

summary.brief: A driver guides a black sedan through a residential parking area while instructional text is displayed.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with red instructional text “Bay Parking Between 2 Cars Right & Left” overlaid on the driver’s view through the windshield and dashboard of a black four‑door sedan. The driver, a man, holds the steering wheel and makes small left‑right movements as a blue car passes on the right side of the road. The vehicle proceeds forward down a street lined with brick houses, a shopping cart near a white parked car, and other traffic, all under an overcast sky. The dashboard remains visible while the camera occasionally pans to show a piece of paper at the windshield edge, a construction site, and blue and white cars parked on either side of the lane. A nearby car backs out of a spot and the front bumper of another vehicle crosses the frame. The view continues past a pedestrian and a dog on the sidewalk, with red buildings and a chain fence in the background. Near the end the camera zooms in on the air‑conditioning vent; a white car that had been parked nearby pulls out of its space and drives away.

action.detailed: Steer the black sedan forward, adjusting the wheel as needed while checking the side mirrors and monitoring surrounding parked cars and other traffic, and continue through the lot until a nearby white car pulls out of its space.
action.actor: The driver of the black sedan, a man seated in the front seat
